content_descriptors.notes:
The game features dismemberment/gore of fictional monsters that are the main enemies in the game.

Additionally some cutscenes contain cartoony dismemberment as well as blood and dead bodies.

name: Chain Shotgun

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2.4 GHz Dual Core Processor Or Higher
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Or Equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Chain Shotgun is a fast paced movement shooter where your only weapon is the multi-barrelled CHAIN SHOTGUN. Two barrels are way too few! With an up-to-infinite amount of barrels, it can shoot anything from sniper rounds, rockets, slime - LEGS? Why not even load it with yourself?
